recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-3823 unless a future work group decision changes ele-1 or the empty Parameters exception.
issue_request: FHIR-3823 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core formats after an example used an id-only element (`<vaccineType id="396427003"/>`) that should have failed validation.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-3823 was found; Jira comments say the issue was fixed already. The clearest source-history trail is the later FHIR-8247/#8247 commit 3b6ebf56c2, which added the Element/global invariant and Element constraints page include.
additional_context: Element is an active normative infrastructure type in source/fhir.ini. Current ele-1 requires a value or non-id children, with the later FHIR-26565 exception for empty Parameters resources already represented on the combined branch. The original vaccineType/396427003 fragment is not present in current source, and community searches found no conflicting context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/datatypes/element.xml already defines the required content rule and source/types.html exposes Element constraints.

related_jiras.note: Made the Element/global invariant visible and provided the source-history trail for the current rule.
Later allowed empty Parameters resources through ele-1 without undoing the id-only element validation requested by FHIR-3823.
